eras.name: Phase 2 — logline method
eras.summary: The METHOD: ban failure CLASSES + mandate the positive alternative; contrastive weak/strong pairs; gated rubrics calibrated to fail known-bads; regression fixture per failure. Applied to the logline final clause (insight-ending ban).

eras.name: Phase 3 — budgeted live protocol
eras.summary: Live-testing protocol (rounds ≤3, hard caps, actual-cost logging, stop rules); killed menu endings + bible-priming override clause. 4 calls, $0.0106.

eras.name: Creative Quality Gauntlet

eras.name: Logline v5 — imported-scaffolding ban
eras.summary: Pressure must come from the project's own material; banned invented clocks/return-missions; third contrastive pair. 2/2 live.

eras.name: Taste alignment — edge preservation
eras.summary: Premise-sovereignty principle + EDGE_PRESERVATION_RULES (anti-sanitization AND hard lines) in 6 content-creating asks; cast corollary. Live 2/2, $0.026.
